name: spotify
description: Spotify as a mod: an OAuth 2.0 (authorization code + PKCE) adapter for the Spotify Web API, exposed as 21 MCP tools, a REST mirror and a browser console on one port. Search the catalog, drive playback and the queue across devices, read recently-played and top tracks/artists, and build playlists — by spotify: URI, open.spotify.com link, or plain phrase, which the module resolves by search. Every call runs on the caller's own account: credentials and tokens live in ~/.mod/spotify/ at 0600, never in this file, and a request may carry its own bearer instead. Python stdlib only.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies

auth.flow: OAuth 2.0 authorization code + PKCE (client secret optional)
auth.byok: authorization: Bearer <spotify access token> per HTTP request, or token= per MCP call — never persisted
auth.premium: playback control (play/pause/skip/volume/queue) requires Spotify Premium; search, library and playlist reads do not

env.SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID: app client id, checked before the keystore
env.SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET: app client secret (optional under PKCE; required for catalog-only client-credentials access)
env.SPOTIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN: use this bearer instead of the stored tokens
